messages:
Nina: Quick idea: 'closure-by-action' rule. don't close postmortem until every remediation has an owner+due. reduces drift.

Ravi: Yes. also require a 72h acknowledgment from owner or auto-escalate to oncall lead.

Jordan: Can we have tags on actions so we can query recurring sources (eg: kv-cache, routing, quantization)?

Nina: Proposed tiny follow-up template we can paste in the PM: 
- owner: @ravi
- due: 2026-06-04
- brief: rollback batch-size; add monitoring
- tags: kv-cache,memory-pressure
- status: open/in-progress/done

oncall-bot: Command: `/followup create --owner @ravi --due 2026-06-04 --tags kv-cache --notify 3d,7d,14d,30d`

Ravi: I'll wire bot hooks to create a GH issue when tags include `infra`. 30min spike tomorrow.

Jordan: Also suggest a 2-week IC window and a 1-week shadow for smoother handoffs. add to runbook.

Nina: Plan: Ravi spike -> bot PR -> add template to runbook. thanks.

oncall-bot: Reminders scheduled: 3d,7d,14d,30d.
